runtime_config.decision_rule: Blocked host, missing controls or incomplete comparison => INCONCLUSIVE_REVISE, no model ranking. Complete inadequate comparison => DEFER. Passing permits only a supervised opt-in integration experiment under separate #75 authorization.
runtime_config.metal: not attempted; support unverified; requires a separate frozen variant
runtime_config.execution: Rust preview only; no approval or RDF execution command; no #75 integration
runtime_config.thermal: No thermal/performance warning, CPU limits absent or 100 percent; AC power required
runtime_config.mode: diagnostic_only: independent semantic observations; no semantic GO or strict evaluation
runtime_config.evaluation_exposure: All 30 #72 evaluation cases already exposed by #74; not a pristine holdout
runtime_config.hypothesis: Explicit object-anchored reverse plan construction improves exposed reverse-reference agreement; predicate meaning remains an independent limitation.
runtime_config.controls_before_smoke: All semantic controls and six smoke cases attempted independently in each condition. Semantic failure and individually rejected drafts remain failures. Runtime, integrity, resource and authorization failures stop all later observations.
runtime_config.scoring: Original exact exposed-reference scores immutable. Ambiguity and source-evidence audit reported separately; pending independent human review.
runtime_config.scope_policy: Original authorized source only. Separate oracle and frozen whole-question BM25-v1 diagnostic records; neighborhood-v2 not registered.
runtime_config.source_evidence: Same authorized source edges and collisions as v1d; source names grouped by original language, predicate IRI local names extracted mechanically. No translations, invented property definitions, selected IDs or gold directions.

repeatability.gate: Diagnostic measurement only; failed repeat recorded. Exact prompt and request identity mismatch is a fatal integrity failure.

rationale_review.method: Blind independent human review pending; source sufficiency audit is AI investigator analysis only.
rationale_review.gate: No semantic GO; unsupported or unreviewed claims are not validated.

runtime_config.comparison: Original Qwen status-precedence first evidence; only reverse one-hop construction wording changes.
runtime_config.token_fit_rule: input_tokens + 512 < 16384; every scheduled prompt is recounted with pinned local tokenizer before model loading; native template/token parity is mandatory before each generation

primary_evaluation.primary_target: Measure exposed reverse-reference agreement separately in each condition, including every failed or unattempted observation; no semantic correctness claim.
primary_evaluation.supported_regressions: List every lost baseline candidate, forward regression, wrong-start and wrong-direction candidate; keep exposed references and separate AI ambiguity audit unchanged.

reporting: Full 36-observation schedule plus two sampling controls; retain partial, failed and unattempted outcomes with null missing semantics; paired completed identities separately.
All five plan fields, forward and reverse separately; model status distinct from Rust rejection.
Source-table/rationale contradictions independently with exact raw excerpts, source paths and values; narrow automatic detection is not sufficient.
Source sufficiency limits, four-case AI ambiguity audit, native controls, canaries, latency and sampled process-tree RSS; human judgments remain null.

Separate each of the five plan fields, predicate/graph-binding contradictions, source insufficiency and missing numeric vocabulary. Full scheduled oracle 19 and retrieval 17, reverse 2 each, unsupported 6 each, clarification 3 each; paired completed denominators separately.
No statistical superiority, exact-answer accuracy, independent-human-review or semantic-readiness claim.

protocol.prompt: Unchanged #102 direction-only system prompt in every semantic observation; unchanged sampling-control prompt.

construction.question: Can the model construct a forward/reverse plan given an exact predicate, start and graph IRI?
construction.panel: All 60 mechanically generated explicit-predicate-development-v1 questions, original order; original oracle vocabulary, no added metadata. No historical natural-language comparison is a causal ablation.
construction.expected: Original source-derived five fields and graph-qualified witnesses, including empty paths. Empty paths still require the explicit requested candidate; literal objects are never starts.
construction.primary: Exact status and all five fields, separately forward/reverse and witnessed/empty_path; every field and wrong-start/direction individually. Mechanical request fidelity, not natural-language semantic correctness.

metadata.question: Does verified retained source metadata improve natural-language interpretation at fixed vocabulary membership?
metadata.panel: All 30 unchanged exposed natural-language evaluation questions plus the retained v1e-label-explicit source-injection control, each paired with/without metadata; original full oracle membership only.
metadata.only_factor: Predicate source_metadata arrays: empty versus exact mapped retained labels/descriptions. Source graph/role/numeric membership, original question, system prompt, entity names, usages, collision warnings, grammar, runtime, sampling and scoring references identical within each pair. Packet identities differ only in host sidecars. No explicit-IRI rewording in this experiment.
metadata.order: Original question order, injection last; no_metadata first for even zero-based pair index, metadata first for odd index. Single sequential process, fresh independent completion per observation.
metadata.primary: Paired change in unchanged exposed-AI-reference agreement, with all scheduled and paired-completed denominators. Five fields and model-origin statuses independently; forward/reverse and control categories separately. Missing outcomes are null, never successes. Unchanged ambiguity audit and source insufficiency remain separate from reference agreement.
metadata.negative_controls: Non-Wikidata relations have no newly mapped meanings. Report these separately from relations with verified metadata; do not invent W3C/Schema/GEMET property meanings from local names or concept definitions.

controls.ambiguous_identity: eva-20 Campus; source-label ambiguity eva-06 retained as an exposed-reference tension, never relabeled
controls.source_injection: v1e-label-explicit in both metadata arms; every source string untrusted/inert; no generated query execution
controls.stale_packet: Model-free rejection of changed source, metadata, graph-qualified binding, context or saved packet identity before Rust preview
controls.incorrect_direction: Model-free intentionally flipped candidate may pass Rust but must fail field scoring; all scheduled explicit reverse probes remain included
controls.native: Before any future generation: fresh unchanged host/resource admission, asset checks, constrained/unconstrained sampling controls and fresh native template/token-array parity for EVERY exact message; 12 existing grammar accept/reject controls. Fatal integrity/runtime/resource failure stops remaining requests; ordinary interpretation errors remain observations.

protocol.resource_limits: Inherit original #102 config verbatim: 1024 MiB swap admission, 24 GiB sampled process-tree RSS, 16384 context, 512 output reserve, input+512 strictly below 16384, 4 CPU threads, zero GPU layers, concurrency 1, 300-second completion deadline, zero retries. No limit relaxation or downloads.
protocol.interpretation: Explicit-IRI failures with complete vocabulary indicate request-to-plan construction problems even without predicate meanings. Explicit success plus metadata-only paired gains is evidence consistent with missing source meaning; no gain does not prove metadata is irrelevant. Persistent ambiguity, language mismatch and exposed-reference tensions can remain. Synthetic checks prove engineering contracts only. Rust acceptance, reference agreement and independent semantic correctness are separate.
protocol.reporting: Retain original raw bytes/SSE, every failed/unattempted request, prompt/token/native parity, GBNF, Rust preview, latency/RSS, model status and five fields; report full and paired denominators, target-metadata availability, exact source evidence and rationale contradictions. Human correctness stays null; no superiority/readiness or real-world truth claim. No RDF execution.
protocol.authorization: Preparation, registration and scoring are model-free. No native runner is exposed here. A future runner/review and separate explicit authorization naming this exact archive, reviewed revision, 126-request cap and fresh output are required. No merge, holdout, #75, reference rewrite or source download is authorized.
